people.name: Martha
people.line: Sister of Mary and Lazarus, hosted Jesus.

people.name: Mary

translations.web: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
translations.bsb: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary to console them in the loss of their brother.
